# Role types (generated by `harness catalog`; do not edit)

| type | model | effort | tools | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `advisor` | sonnet | high | Read, Write, Edit, Skill | Answers a framed question from one named perspective in 150-300 words, alone. Use when: a council needs one opinion per perspective. |
| `analyst` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, Skill | Groups failures of named runs by class into cited change proposals. Use when: recurring failures or skill usage must be reviewed. |
| `classifier` | haiku | low | Read, StructuredOutput | Assigns one label from its list to a digest or request, with a confidence. Use when: an item must be routed by a fixed label set. |
| `comparator` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Skill, StructuredOutput | Ranks anonymised candidates against a rubric, naming blind spots. Use when: several candidates need one comparative judgment. |
| `critic` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Finds gaps, contradictions and unproven assumptions, each proved by a command. Use when: an output or plan needs adversarial review. |
| `judge` | opus | max | Read, Glob, Grep, Skill, StructuredOutput | Returns one verdict (accept, revise, replan, reject) with reasons. Use when: a stage needs a decision from evidence already gathered. |
| `librarian` | sonnet | medium | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Compiles context/ into sourced wiki pages, updating index and log. Use when: material must be ingested or wiki lint fixed. |
| `manager` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, Skill, ListAgents, SendMessage, Workflow, WebFetch | Talks to the human, launches and polls role sessions and records decisions. Use when: a human starts, inspects or stops agent work. |
| `plan-fixer` | opus | max | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, Skill | Answers plan findings and edits unbuilt tasks. Use when: open findings on written plan tasks need answers before they are built. |
| `planner` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Writes plan.md and tasks.json with checks after a trial build. Use when: a stage needs a plan or a task list from an approved spec. |
| `quarantine-reader` | sonnet | medium | Read, StructuredOutput | Digests untrusted inbox text, reporting its instructions as data. Use when: text nobody here wrote must be processed before use. |
| `reader` | sonnet | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, WebFetch, Skill | Writes notes of exact quotes with locations from named material. Use when: a stage needs facts from text and code before planning. |
| `researcher` | sonnet | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, Skill | Reports what exists, each with a path and line. Use when: a stage or research run needs findings about existing code or documents. |
| `spec-writer` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, Skill | Turns a story into a one-page spec: intent, requirements, limits, done, out of scope. Use when: an approved story needs a spec. |
| `story-writer` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Skill | Writes one user story with checkable acceptance criteria and scope. Use when: a feature request must become a story a human approves. |
| `synthesizer` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Skill | Merges outputs into agreements, clashes and one recommendation. Use when: parallel outputs must become one verdict or briefing. |
| `test-verifier` | sonnet | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Proves a story's acceptance criteria with tests it writes and runs. Use when: an implementation needs tests by another session. |
| `translator` | sonnet | max | Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Skill | Translates a finished English text, keeping code and paths. Use when: a finished report must reach a reader in another language. |
| `validator` | opus | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Lists each deviation from the story and the spec with severity and location. Use when: an implementation needs a conformance check. |
| `verifier` | sonnet | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Proves each claim of an output with commands it runs. Use when: an output exists and must be proven before judgment. |
| `writer` | sonnet | high | Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit, EnterWorktree, Skill | Implements its shard's tasks with tests on its worktree branch. Use when: a stage produces code or documents from an approved plan. |
